claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: For every Boolean core g and every fresh one-word d-bit activation F with p=2^{-d}, G(F)<=pG(g)+320p(W_1(g)+L_1(g))+C_* I_ctl, where C_*<4.947.
claims.quantifiers: All n>=0, Boolean g on n uniform bits, all integers d>=1, and every activation word.
limitations: Retains terminal singleton mass and entropy; it is not universal GU'.

claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: For every finite nested fresh-activation chain f_m over one fixed Boolean terminal core g, G(f_m)<=q_mG(g)+640q_mL_1(g)+1920q_mW_1(g)+C_chain I_ctl(f_m), with C_chain<10324 independent of depth, block sizes, activation probability, bias, and dimension.
claims.quantifiers: All terminal dimensions, all Boolean cores, all finite m, all integer block sizes d_t>=1, and arbitrary activation words on mutually fresh control blocks.
limitations: Requires one fixed terminal core through the chain.
Does not control arbitrary trees with changing coherent cores.

claims.label: PROVED_RESTRICTED_CLASS
claims.statement: Every finite nested fresh one-word activation of a signed parity satisfies H(f)<20650 I(f), uniformly in depth, control-block sizes, terminal dimension, and activation rarity.
claims.scope: Restriction-closed proper class; not full FEI.

claims.label: NUMERICAL_CORROBORATION
claims.statement: Direct Walsh checks passed 1,434 one-layer and 2,664 hierarchy cases, including the mandatory structured controls and exact singleton-ledger identities.
claims.scope: Finite falsifier search only; the theorem is analytic.

claims.label: OPEN
claims.statement: No universal GU' estimate, full FEI proof, or genuine Boolean counterfamily with unbounded H/I is established by this run.
